reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, wide-packet re-review batch 4, 2026-08-01

samples_reviewed.question_text: What is the total value of 1 ₱50 bill, 1 ₱5 coin, and 1 ₱1 coin?
What is the total value of 1 ₱10 coin and 1 ₱1 coin?
What is the total value of 1 ₱5 coin and 1 ₱1 coin?
What is the total value of 2 ₱1 coins?
What is the total value of 2 ₱20 bills and 1 ₱5 coin?
Count the coins and bills shown. What is the total amount?
Use coins and bills to make exactly ₱21. Use the fewest pieces possible.
What is the total value of 2 ₱10 coins and 1 ₱1 coin?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The competency names four cases (centavo coins only, peso coins only, peso bills only, combined); peso-coins-only (43, 44, 45, 72) and combined bills-and-coins (42, 46, 50) are both well represented, but centavo-only and peso-bills-only never appear.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: 'Centavo coins only,' one of four cases explicitly named in the competency text, never appears in any of the 8 samples -- every value shown is a whole-peso denomination (₱50, ₱20, ₱10, ₱5, ₱1); 'peso bills only' also never appears, since every bill-containing sample (42, 46) mixes in a coin.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Totals like 56, 45, and 21 pesos, computed from named bill/coin counts such as '2 ₱20 bills and 1 ₱5 coin' (seed 46), fit G2Q2 money-arithmetic demand.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Formats span direct computation (mcq/cloze), visual counting (seed 50's 'Count the coins and bills shown'), and construction (seed 55's 'make exactly ₱21 ... fewest pieces possible'), giving genuine framing variety.

competency_alignment.rationale: The variation across different denomination combinations and formats, e.g. seed 45's '2 ₱1 coins' versus seed 42's mixed bill-and-coin set, targets the actual money-valuation skill named by the competency.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The ceiling is ₱1000, but the highest total across all 8 samples is ₱56 (seed 42); no sample approaches even ₱100, and higher-denomination bills like ₱100 or ₱500 never appear here.
